capabilities: Preview rows with caps and filtering
Run read-only SELECT and WITH queries
disambiguation: Not a general SQL IDE or database editor; it only inspects SQLite files read-only and omits editing, exports, and charting.
extras: Bundles sql.js (SQLite compiled to WebAssembly) into main.js, making it much larger than a plain text viewer; the elapsed-time guard cannot interrupt a single expensive synchronous query step. Also registers WAL/SHM sidecar extensions to show an explanation instead of failing.
intentEvidence: This plugin exists only as a minimal, stricter read-only variant.
motivation: The author built it as a minimal, stricter read-only variant because existing community plugins already cover broader SQLite workflows.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open or inspect the local SQLite database files stored in a vault.

relations.evidence: SQLite Explorer is close to this scope and offers table selection, schema inspection, and a read-only SQL runner.
SQLite DB Viewer uses sql.js and describes broader query/edit/visualization behavior.
SQLite DB focuses on queries, charts, and exports from notes.

summary: Read-only viewer that opens local SQLite database files to browse tables, views, schemas, and run capped SELECT queries.
